_doc: Cases for the e2e harness (test-e2e/install.test.mjs reads this shape from cases.json: blocks.<name>.cases and chains; merge these keys there). `extended` holds assertions the harness does not consume yet (install-time conflicts, on_conflict); each was run by hand with the kit CLI against a copy of templates/hono-d1. The no-KV degradation is asserted inside test/api-keys.test.ts (a no-cache env and a failing-KV env), so every verify run covers it.
